Fixture: 41_rgba_gradient_16x16_lossless.jxl
16x16 RGBA gradient, mathematically lossless, effort 7 --
resets_canvas sharing probe (F.2 / F.7)

Purpose
-------
Aimed at RESETS_CANVAS_SHARED_ACROSS_BUNDLES
(jpxl-decode/src/frame/header.rs): whether resets_canvas is computed once
from the colour blending_info and shared with every ec_blending_info bundle
(this crate's reading) or re-evaluated per bundle against that bundle's own
mode. Needs at least one extra channel for ec_blending_info to exist; alpha
is the only extra channel a PAM/PNG source can carry through cjxl's CLI.

Result: negative, but useful anyway. See
docs/experiments/2026-08-03-flip-point-fixtures.md. This decoder now decodes
this fixture end to end (jpxl_decode::decode) -- the first RGBA modular
extra-channel fixture in this project's test corpus. Both the colour and the
extra channel's blending_info.mode come back kReplace, so the two readings of
resets_canvas cannot be told apart by this stream: there is no cjxl CLI lever
that sets an extra channel's blend mode independently of the colour channel's
for a single, non-animated frame. The ambiguity itself is exercised instead by
a hand-built bitstream unit test,
frame::header::tests::resets_canvas_is_shared_from_the_colour_bundle.

                tools/oracle-bin/PINNED_REVISIONS.txt)

                used, converted, or consulted. 16x16 8-bit RGBA (PAM P7,
                TUPLTYPE RGB_ALPHA):
                  R = x * 15 mod 256, G = y * 15 mod 256, B = (x + y) mod 256
                  A = 128 if (x + y) even else 255

Verification
------------
djxl decodes it to a PAM byte-identical to the source (checked on every run of
tools/make-experiment-fixtures.sh). jpxl_decode::decode() also decodes it
successfully (see tests/e2e_experiments.rs).

cjxl is used strictly as a BLACK BOX: it emits conformant streams for JPXL to
parse. libjxl's source is never read. If a rebuild at a different libjxl
revision changes these digests, that is the point of recording them -- do not
silently update them; note the revision change.
